# Tests that are noisy on a shared runner: timing budgets. A pull request and a release skip them;
# the nightly full run keeps them, so a real regression still shows within a day. The native
# memory-growth check (AH-221) runs alone in every CI run instead: see .github/solo-tests.txt. One test name per line; blank lines and # comments are ignored.
# A renamed test only runs early again, never drops out of the nightly run.
